guidance.speaker: Rajeev Gupta
guidance.quote: So whatever guidance this year, we have upgraded to grow by 25%, so we are still maintaining that we will grow more than 25% because nobody knows that in future copper price will go up or copper price will go down.

guidance.summary: EBITDA margin will be close to 11%
guidance.speaker: Rajeev Gupta
guidance.quote: So our guidance is still maintaining that we will be growing at a 25%-plus growth rate and our EBITDA margin will be close to 11%.

guidance.speaker: Rajeev Gupta
guidance.quote: Export is increasing robust way. And in the coming quarters, the export will also grow. But our growth rate will be depending on the geopolitical situation, competition as we repeatedly saying that will be 25% plus and EBITDA margin will be 11%, where we grow from export or we grow from the dealer distributor or we will grow from the domestic institution side.

guidance.summary: Guidance was close to 11% moving towards 11% to 12%
guidance.speaker: Rajeev Gupta
guidance.quote: Sir, margin was -- our guidance was close to 11% for the current financial year because in the same call, we were referring in the month of May, we were -- at that time also, we have said that first, we will go to 11% to 11.5%, then we will go from 11.5% to 12% because as the Sanand KEI Industries Limited October 22, 2026 Page 7 of 19 capacity will ramp up, the margin will get improved because of the export market, because of the EHV increase, because of the economy of scale.

guidance.speaker: Rajeev Gupta
guidance.quote: Sir, there is no confusion. The guidance is 11% to 12%. 11% to 12% was also for the next financial year.
